parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity or expression, and gender identity has been covered by discrimination law since 2005, with 2014 amendments extending it to goods, services and health. Documented protective enforcement includes a prosecution over conversion practices and a pending-but-endorsed ban. Public visibility is high (about 100,000 at Pride). Against this, police hate-crime counts are rising, but they are raw, undenominated and LGBT-wide rather than trans-specific, so they carry little rate weight. The 40% care-access survey is resident-facing and undated. Border document handling, facility access and detention placement are unsourced open questions, not documented exposures, so they lighten the score only slightly. No traveller-facing exclusion or organised targeting is documented.
